398:             terminal = bool(outcome or session_time.get("idle"))
399:         except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError) as error:
400:             interrupt_result = {"error": f"interrupt_error:{type(error).__name__}"}
401: 
402:     recovery_path = _save_recovery_export(directory, session_id, raw)
403:     return {
404:         "recovered": True,
405:         "session_id": session_id,
406:         "title": expected_title,
407:         "outcome": outcome,
408:         "terminal": terminal,
409:         "interrupt_attempted": interrupt_result is not None,
410:         "interrupt": interrupt_result,
411:         "export_path": recovery_path,
412:     }
413: 
414: 
415: def _write_cycle_receipt(result: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
416:     CYCLE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
417:     stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
418:     path = CYCLE_ROOT / f"{stamp}.v6-cycle-receipt.json"
419:     with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as target:
420:         json.dump(result, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
421:         target.write("\n")
422:     return str(path)
423:

425: def run_cycle(assignment: str, seconds: int = 120) -> dict[str, Any]:
426:     """Run one explicitly bounded assignment in a fresh visible session."""
427:     if not isinstance(assignment, str) or not assignment.strip():
428:         raise ValueError("assignment must be non-empty text")
429:     if isinstance(seconds, bool) or not isinstance(seconds, int) or not 15 <= seconds <= 1800:
430:         raise ValueError("seconds must be an integer from 15 through 1800")
431:     required_tools = explicit_tool_sequence(assignment)
432:     if not required_tools:
433:         return {"cycle_succeeded": False, "stop_reason": "architect_assignment_has_no_explicit_tool_scope"}
434:     if len(required_tools) > 8:
435:         return {"cycle_succeeded": False, "stop_reason": "architect_tool_sequence_exceeds_eight_steps"}
436:     unsupported = [tool for tool in required_tools if tool not in SUPPORTED_TOOLS]
437:     if unsupported:
438:         return {"cycle_succeeded": False, "stop_reason": "unsupported_tool", "unsupported_tools": unsupported}
439: 
440:     assignment_bytes = len(assignment.strip().encode("utf-8"))
441:     if "aios_router_open_build_task" in required_tools and assignment_bytes > 2000:
442:         result = {
443:             "cycle_succeeded": False,
444:             "stop_reason": "router_assignment_exceeds_utf8_byte_limit",
445:             "session_mode": "not_started",
446:             "agent": "drone_build",
447:             "session_id": None,
448:             "required_tools": required_tools,
449:             "assignment_utf8_bytes": assignment_bytes,
450:             "assignment_utf8_byte_limit": 2000,
451:             "assignment_sha256": hashlib.sha256(assignment.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
452:         }
453:         result["cycle_receipt"] = _write_cycle_receipt(result)
454:         return result
455: 
456:     preflight = _rust_preflight()
457:     if not preflight.get("valid") or not preflight.get("allowed"):
458:         result = {
459:             "cycle_succeeded": False,
460:             "stop_reason": "preflight_rust_gate_hold" if preflight.get("valid") else "preflight_rust_gate_invalid",
461:             "session_mode": "not_started",
462:             "agent": "drone_read" if set(required_tools) <= {"read"} else "drone_build",
463:             "session_id": None,
464:             "preflight_observation": preflight,
465:             "assignment_sha256": hashlib.sha256(assignment.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
466:         }
467:         result["cycle_receipt"] = _write_cycle_receipt(result)
468:         return result
469: 
470:     tool_scope = " → ".join(required_tools)
471:     agent_name = "drone_read" if set(required_tools) <= {"read"} else "drone_build"
472:     prompt = f"""[ARCHITECT ASSIGNMENT | CURRENT AND AUTHORIZED]
473: {assignment.strip()}
474: 
475: [CURRENT AUTHORIZATION FACT]
476: The Architect authorized this bounded LocalCoder task. The Queen fixed the exact tool sequence to: {tool_scope}. OpenCode permission checks and the Rust WSL Docker Body gate remain authoritative.
477: 
478: [QUEEN → DRONE]
479: Execute only that sequence, in order, one tool at a time. Do not retry a denied or failed tool. After each non-final tool result, emit a visible [DRONE SELF-PROMPT] with exactly these labels on separate lines: Agenda:, Verified facts:, Next bounded action:. Every field must contain non-empty text; do not put commas after labels. Verified facts must cite the latest actual tool evidence, not the path or directory name alone. Name the next assigned tool in Next bounded action. After the final tool, combine the report and self-prompt in one final message: it must start exactly with [DRONE], state the actual target filename and one concrete fact from returned content, then end with [DRONE SELF-PROMPT] and the same fields, each non-empty and on its own line. Final Verified facts must repeat one concrete fact anchor from the read output and include the exact shell output when a shell check was assigned. Next bounded action must be STOP. Do not invent tool results or claim unverified work."""
480: 
481:     # Omitting session_id creates a fresh visible action session for this task.
482:     work = _dispatch(prompt, seconds, agent_name=agent_name)
483:     self_check_validation = _validate_self_check_output(assignment, work)
484:     if self_check_validation is not None:
485:         work["exit_only_final_shell_check_passed"] = work.get("final_shell_check_passed")
486:         work["final_shell_check_passed"] = bool(self_check_validation.get("passed"))
487:         if not self_check_validation.get("passed"):
488:             work["task_succeeded"] = False
489:             errors = work.setdefault("task_errors", [])
490:             if isinstance(errors, list) and self_check_validation["reason"] not in errors:
491:                 errors.append(self_check_validation["reason"])
492:     sessions = work.get("sessions", [])
493:     session_id = sessions[0] if isinstance(sessions, list) and len(sessions) == 1 else None
494:     recovery = None
495:     if work.get("timed_out") or not session_id or not work.get("session_exports_terminal"):
496:         recovery = _recover_session(work)
497:         work["session_recovery"] = recovery
498:         if not session_id and recovery.get("session_id"):
499:             session_id = recovery["session_id"]
500:             work["sessions"] = [session_id]
501:         if not work.get("session_outcomes") and recovery.get("outcome"):
502:             work["session_outcomes"] = [recovery["outcome"]]
503: 
504:     dispatcher_final_text = list(work.get("final_text", []))
505:     final_parts = _post_tool_final_text(work)
506:     final_text = "\n".join(final_parts or dispatcher_final_text)
507:     work["dispatcher_final_text"] = dispatcher_final_text
508:     work["final_text"] = [final_text] if final_text else []
509:     final_ok, final_reason = validate_final(final_text, work, required_tools)
510:     read_evidence_validation = None
511:     source_line_validation = _validate_source_line_limit(assignment)
512:     if final_ok and required_tools.count("read") == 1:
513:         read_passed, read_reason, read_details = _validate_read_evidence(
514:             final_text, assignment, work, session_id
515:         )
516:         read_evidence_validation = {
517:             "passed": read_passed,
518:             "reason": read_reason,
519:             **read_details,
520:         }
521:         final_ok = read_passed
522:         if not read_passed:
523:             final_reason = read_reason
524:     intermediate = _intermediate_self_prompts(work, required_tools)
525:     gates = _body_gate_receipts(session_id) if session_id else []
526:     gate_ok = bool(gates) and all(
527:         item["allowed"]
528:         and item["disposition"] == "ALLOW_MIND_RUNTIME"
529:         and item["authority"] == "deterministic_aios_body_rust"
530:         for item in gates
531:     )
532:     no_recovery_failure = recovery is None
533:     cycle_succeeded = bool(
534:         no_recovery_failure
535:         and work.get("task_succeeded")
536:         and work.get("session_exports_terminal")
537:         and not work.get("timed_out")
538:         and len(work.get("sessions", [])) == 1
539:         and final_ok
540:         and intermediate.get("passed")
541:         and (self_check_validation is None or self_check_validation.get("passed"))
542:         and (source_line_validation is None or source_line_validation.get("passed"))
543:         and gate_ok
544:     )
545:     result: dict[str, Any] = {
546:         "cycle_succeeded": cycle_succeeded,
547:         "stop_reason": "verified_and_stopped" if cycle_succeeded else (
548:             recovery.get("error", "session_recovery_required") if recovery else
549:             intermediate.get("reason") if not intermediate.get("passed") else
550:             self_check_validation["reason"] if self_check_validation is not None and not self_check_validation.get("passed") else
551:             source_line_validation["reason"] if source_line_validation is not None and not source_line_validation.get("passed") else
552:             final_reason if not final_ok else "work_or_body_gate_verification_failed"
553:         ),
554:         "session_mode": "fresh_visible_action_session",
555:         "agent": agent_name,
556:         "session_id": session_id,
557:         "session_recovery": recovery,
558:         "model_ids": work.get("model_ids", []),
559:         "required_tools": required_tools,
560:         "final_validation": final_reason,
561:         "self_check_validation": self_check_validation,
562:         "read_evidence_validation": read_evidence_validation,
563:         "source_line_validation": source_line_validation,
564:         "intermediate_validation": {
565:             "passed": intermediate.get("passed"),
566:             "reason": intermediate.get("reason"),
567:         },
568:         "body_gate_receipts": gates,
569:         "preflight_observation": preflight,
570:         "assignment_sha256": hashlib.sha256(assignment.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
571:         "work": work,
572:     }
573:     result["cycle_receipt"] = _write_cycle_receipt(result)
574:     return result
575: 
576: 
577: def main() -> int:
578:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
579:     parser.add_argument("assignment_file", type=Path)
580:     parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=120)
581:     args = parser.parse_args()
582:     result = run_cycle(args.assignment_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"), args.seconds)
583:     print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))
584:     return 0 if result.get("cycle_succeeded") else 1
585: 
586: 
587: if __name__ == "__main__":
588:     sys.exit(main())

# LocalCoder Workspace Map

Read `L:\LocalCoder\AGENTS.md` first.

## Existing systems to reuse

- `viv_autonomy.py` and `autonomy\state.sqlite3`: persistent autonomous task loop, events, capabilities, training, evaluation, and promotion gates.
- `viv_chat_cli.py`: existing user-facing Viv entry point.
- `hive_control`: Rust task graph, capability, snapshot, channel, and receipt contracts.
- `swarm_adapters`: local Qwen worker models, LoRA stacks, held-out evaluation, and candidate activation.
- `hive_voice`: one-mouth voice routing.
- `HIVE_NETWORK_ARCHITECTURE_DRAFT.md` and `HIVE_LOCK_MANIFEST.json`: locked Hive topology and evidence boundaries.
- `INN`: learned architect engine and deterministic Rust farm.

## Current coupling direction

Current farm training: Architect -> GPU model Queen -> CPU own neural INN drone proposal -> Queen selection -> Rust execution and verification. The legacy farm policy remains a reversible fallback.

The Architect intends the INN to become Queen after broader learning and language gates. Do not claim that role switch has already occurred. These current farm roles follow the Architect's explicit direction; preserve the separate locked general Hive contracts.

Own neural training uses `autonomy/train_neural_inn.py`, the admitted checkpoint in `autonomy/learning/neural_admitted.json`, verified live Rust facts, and parent-relative farm/language gates. The Hive launches a bounded CPU attempt every 250 completed lessons by default. Live receipts must distinguish neural proposals, legacy weight updates, and failed candidates. Queen prose is not automatically a verified training target.

The game supplies the common training corpus: `autonomy/farm_corpus.py` publishes immutable hash-addressed snapshots with `inn_train.json` and `model_train.jsonl`. INN training reads its internal view; `autonomy/farm_adapter.py` reuses the existing Hive QLoRA trainer for the model view. Exclude reserved plots 21 and 41, reject conflicting targets, and distinguish legality facts from measured 12-tick strategy improvements. The current Ollama Qwen3-8B Queen cannot use a LoRA trained on the existing local Qwen3-1.7B worker base. Adapter preflight and training receipts must not claim live Queen weights changed before matching-base training, held-out evaluation, conversion, and live verification.

Do not infer that Continue/Viv state is LocalCoder Hive state. Resolve and inspect each runtime separately with the updated `viv-live-foreman` skill.

Custom tokenizer lane: `INN/inn/uml_character_tokenizer.py` is a hash-identical copy of the Architect's universal Unicode tokenizer from Continue/Viv. `INN/inn/tokenizer.py` supplies a frozen compact neural view, retaining universal IDs separately. `LanguageEngine` accepts this tokenizer and a configurable token context; checkpoints bind both. Legacy byte checkpoints retain their original contract. `Rebuild-INNTokenizer.ps1` runs a bounded language-only migration/training/evaluation candidate, writes `autonomy/learning/inn_tokenizer_status.json`, and does not replace the admitted farm INN. `Speak-INNTokenizer.ps1` inspects that candidate. Character integration does not establish Wikipedia knowledge or word/BPE curriculum completion.

Wikipedia sentence scaling: `autonomy/wiki_sentence_corpus.py` creates a bounded lead-sentence pilot from F:/AI_Datasets/wikipedia_deduplicated, excluding redirects/markup and recording aligned original/reduced views with conjunction offsets. Reduction is mechanical deletion, not a guaranteed semantic rewrite. `Train-INNSentences.ps1` trains the character INN on the reduced view with prior-skill replay, deterministic article/sentence order, 512-token context and a 600-second update-loop ceiling. Whole articles are split before training; cross-split identical targets are excluded. Results are development evaluations, not evidence of general factual generation. The structure pass remains closed until a separate generation-quality evaluation passes. Never promote a candidate just because NLL fell.

Full Wikipedia continuation uses `Train-INNWikipedia.ps1` and `autonomy/train_inn_wikipedia.py`, with `autonomy/wiki_stream.py` reading prose from all article sections. The experimental campaign head at `autonomy/learning/wikipedia_campaign/head.json` binds checkpoint hash, Adam optimizer continuity, dataset cursor, pending corpus hash and chunk offset in one atomic commit. Each command resumes this head; it does not restart the pilot parent. An expanded compact character vocabulary remaps existing weights and Adam moments by character identity. Commands stop after their update budget, the pending segment's first training traversal, or a 600-second update-loop ceiling; `-Segments` requests a bounded sequence of commands. Reading a file, preparing an article or presenting its chunks is not evidence of mastery. Completed eligible articles include reserved evaluation articles. Exact-target split ownership is stored on L: in SQLite; initial pilot overlap and repeated evaluations remain development evidence. Retention failures preserve the rejected run and leave the campaign head unchanged. Training stays on L:, source reads stay on F:, and the farm admission stays untouched. Stop with less than 2 GiB free on L:; retain receipts and failed candidates.

The matching training base is now `swarm_adapters/models/Qwen3-8B`, pinned to official revision `b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218`. `model_source.json` records upstream hash checks and matching live Queen architecture (36 layers, width 4096). `Train-FarmAdapter.ps1 -Train` performs bounded GPU training and evaluation using existing Hive pause controls and inference locking. It unloads Ollama and leaves farm execution paused after completion or failure. Only explicit `-ResumeFarm` restarts continuous farm execution after the entire successful command. Original base weights remain frozen. `evaluate_farm_adapter.py` compares reserved Rust descriptions before any live activation. A trained adapter or passing language score alone is not a passing Rust farm behavior gate.
